title: Normal-domain property is invariant under ring isomorphism
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings and $e:A\simeq B$ a ring isomorphism. If $A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then $B$ is a normal domain: it is a domain, and every element of its fraction field integral over $B$ lies in $B$.
